QuestInfo.name: Brave Like a Hero
QuestInfo.0: In order to begin real training, you must first figure out which of the five heroes you were, but you don't remember anything... You'd better discuss this with #b#p1201000##k.
QuestInfo.1: #p1201000# tells you while she was excavating heroes from ice, she found a weapon used by one of the heroes. She placed it in town. She wonders if it was yours. If it was, then you would be #bAran, the hero who used a polearm#k...
